The author chose an approachable pause held by the doorway and the robe's drape, rather than a formal ceremonial gesture. baseline_prompt_en: A natural photographic portrait of a fictional adult model wearing a Daoist ceremonial-style robe in a quiet stone entrance hall. The model faces the camera, with the front of the robe clearly visible. The capture camera views the model from the front, and the portrait is framed from head to below the knees. Gentle morning light enters through an open doorway and spreads softly across the robe's front surface. The model stands with an easy, balanced posture; their arms rest beside the body and the long sleeves fall into soft folds. Their relaxed expression and warm direct attention give the encounter a quiet personal appeal. The doorway light, the drape of the cloth and the pale stone behind the model form the portrait's simple rhythm. Keep the robe's visible front and the person's presence equally clear, with natural fabric texture and a gentle transition into the dimmer hall. The pose feels relaxed and unforced, as though the camera has caught an ordinary pause in this still room.
